cases.strongest_licensed_action: Select Route Birch for a verification export for the checkpoint audit; withhold any claim that a file belongs to a checkpoint until the delivered manifest joins its digest to that checkpoint and its approval event. Keep unsigned version 4 outside the approved checkpoint record.

required_method_links.statement: A03 licenses selection of A02 over A01 for checkpoint-level reconstruction.
A04 is the precondition for applying the selection rule.
A05 is the discriminator to inspect after export.
A06 interprets a missing join without inventing approval.
A07 bounds the disposition of the later correction.

required_observable_elements: Choose Route Birch as the candidate for a checkpoint-level verification run, not as an already executed action.
Require the delivered manifest to associate each file digest with its checkpoint and approval event before asserting checkpoint content.
Do not treat the unsigned later correction as approved or as present at checkpoint C-17.
State that no route is recorded as selected or run.
forbidden_overclaims: Claim that Route Alder or Route Birch was already run.
Claim that the approval-event join is already present in an output.
Treat the unsigned correction as an approved checkpoint artifact.

cases.strongest_licensed_action: Keep the cause unresolved and do not change feed concentration from leaf appearance or feed-tank conductivity alone. Request a root-zone conductivity reading after four minutes of recirculation; compare it with the recorded inlet value. A difference of at least 0.6 mS/cm supports root-zone accumulation; a smaller difference leaves salt accumulation and canopy heat unresolved.

required_method_links.statement: A04 links the candidate explanations to A03 as the discriminator.
A05 blocks an unsupported immediate feed change.
A03 specifies the location and timing required for A06.
A06 interprets the possible observation without assigning a cause from missing data.
A07 records the unresolved disposition.

required_observable_elements: Do not declare either cause or change feed concentration from the current observations.
Request the timed root-zone reading after four minutes of recirculation.
Compare the root-zone reading with the recorded inlet value using the 0.6 mS/cm threshold.
If the difference is below 0.6 mS/cm, keep both explanations unresolved.
State that no root-zone reading or cause is currently recorded.
forbidden_overclaims: Claim a root-zone measurement was taken.
Declare salt accumulation or heat as the established cause.
Change feed concentration based only on appearance or feed-tank value.
